tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. All text tokens read on it.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers, filter panels, hover rows, drawing ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled fields, chips, tertiary hover, theme switch track.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed tertiary button, chip hover.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, card and frame edges. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary button edges.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, body and values on canvas, subtle and muted.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Descriptions and spec labels on canvas and subtle.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, units and placeholders on canvas and subtle.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (graphite), selected segment, current page in the pager.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: inverse-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Label on inverse fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Copper signal: selection marker, focus ring, annotation leaders and markers, key data series. Less than 5% of a screen. Never the primary action.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent links on hover.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Highlighted table cell, grid overlay.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (annotation markers, checked checkbox mark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Lifecycle Preview, neutral notices. Text on canvas and info-subtle.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind Preview badges.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Lifecycle Active, passed test. Text on canvas and success-subtle.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind Active badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Lifecycle NRND, change notices. Text on canvas and warning-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind NRND badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Lifecycle EOL, errors, security advisories. Text on canvas and danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind End of life badges.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 16px grid behind product drawings.

tokens.name: draw-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of drawn housings and flanges.

tokens.name: draw-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of drawn parts, 1.5px.

tokens.name: draw-line
tokens.usage: Dimension lines and inner outlines, 1px.

tokens.name: draw-dim
tokens.usage: Dimension values in drawings.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Fixed dark band: cover and footer. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: band-2
tokens.usage: Raised area inside the band (drawing ground on the cover).

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Rules inside the band.

tokens.name: band-text
tokens.usage: Text on band and band-2.

tokens.name: band-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and links on band.
